program: Google for Startups Cloud Program, Start tier (Scale AI later)
verified_from: https://cloud.google.com/startup (read 2026-11-10); the apply URL redirects to a Google account sign-in (302 to accounts.google.com), so the form itself is only visible after sign-in

terms_read.Start: USD 2,000; founded within 2 years, working MVP, clear business model, plans to seek venture funding soon
terms_read.Scale AI: up to USD 350,000 (year 1 100% up to 250,000; year 2 20% up to 100,000); needs verifiable Pre-Seed to Series A venture funding from a known investor; non-venture money does not qualify
terms_read.credits_cover: Google first-party pay-as-you-go products; not third-party models or Marketplace

prerequisites.need: Applicant identity: legal entity or person (BIZ-1)
Business email on the same domain as the public website
prerequisites.probe: applicant.json email domain equals website domain

prerequisites.need: 18-character Google Cloud billing account ID, owned and administered by a user on the company domain
Live website describing company, team/founders and product; placeholder sites are rejected
prerequisites.probe: public site serves product, team and founder pages that pass docs/CONFIDENTIALITY.md

prerequisites.need: No paid Google Workspace purchase on the domain in the 31 days before applying (Scale AI)

answers.What does your company do?: Ultrastable is an autonomous business system. From one idea it sets up and then continuously improves the development, branding, business planning and marketing of a new venture, with AI managers and staff doing the routine work and people approving only the steps that cannot be undone.
answers.Stage: Early stage with a working prototype. It currently runs the founder's own projects; there are no outside customers yet and design-partner pilots are the next step.
answers.Business model: Planned subscription per organization plus pass-through usage. This is a plan, not an established revenue stream.
answers.Funding raised: None. Preparing for a pre-seed round.
answers.Team: One founder; the product runs much of its own operation.
answers.How will you use Google Cloud?: Today the working system has been demonstrated on Cloudflare. Ultrastable is built with a portable core and swappable cloud adapters, and we are willing and able to run it on Google Cloud if funding is available to do so. Credits would fund a Google Cloud deployment: Cloud Run and Cloud Scheduler to run the managers on a heartbeat, Cloud Storage and Secret Manager for records and credentials, then Cloud SQL and Vertex AI (Gemini) as usage grows.
answers.Why Google Cloud?: Customers want a choice of cloud. A Google Cloud deployment gives them one, and Gemini models offer a second model family for the work and for independent review of the work.
answers.Cloud status (accuracy statement): Demonstrated on Cloudflare. A Google Cloud adapter is not yet running in production; running on Google Cloud depends on funding being available.
answers.Website: https://ultrastable.io (must be live with team and product content before submitting; see prerequisites)

submit_steps: Sign in at https://cloud.google.com/startup/apply with the company-domain Google account that owns the billing account
Paste each answer from packet.json (ANSWERS.md); enter billing account ID, business email and website
Enter typed attestations as the applicant; submit
File the confirmation email under business/funding/applications/google-for-startups/confirmations/ and set status to submitted
default_in_effect: Packet drafted and validated; not submitted
closing_probe: confirmations/ holds the Google confirmation email and status is submitted
